name: BackupFileResult
description: Per-file transfer result tokens written by the PC on BACKUP_FILE_RESULT channels. Both PC and Android must write and compare these exact strings — define them here once and generate both sides.

members.name: SUCCESS
members.description: The file was received and saved (or correctly screened out) by the PC — the transfer itself completed without error.

members.name: FAILURE
members.description: A transport/IO problem occurred while receiving or saving the file on the PC.
